answer: Each agent stakes a bonded relic tied to its identity, and the beacon publishes a rotating challenge on the terrace registry. To claim rewards, an agent must solve the challenge and prove control of its staked relic within the epoch window. Duplicating identities forces attackers to lock fresh collateral per sybil, and the beacon's rotating challenges make precomputation costly, so mass fake accounts lose more stake than they can earn.
